# ALAZ

> ALAZ (ALAZ Software) is a small software studio founded in 2026, based in İzmir and New York. We design and build web applications, iOS and Android apps, and the backend systems, APIs and cloud infrastructure behind them, as one team, for companies that need software that keeps working as they grow. We also build and run our own products. The site is available in English and Turkish.

ALAZ is an engineering team, not an agency with account managers: the people who scope a project are the people who build it. Web work is based on Next.js, React, TypeScript and Node.js; mobile apps on Flutter or React Native, with native Swift and Kotlin where needed; infrastructure on PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker and AWS or GCP. A focused MVP or internal tool usually takes 4 to 8 weeks; a multi-app platform 2 to 4 months. Clients own all code and accounts. Every inquiry is read by an engineer and answered within one business day.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://alaz.pro/): what ALAZ does, the products it has shipped and the latest posts
- [Services](https://alaz.pro/services): web applications and SaaS, iOS and Android app development, backend APIs and integrations, cloud infrastructure and DevOps, performance and legacy modernization, with a process section and FAQ
- [Work](https://alaz.pro/case-studies): products ALAZ designed, built and shipped, each with the problem, the build and what shipped
- [About](https://alaz.pro/about): what the name means, how the studio works and the products it runs
- [Blog](https://alaz.pro/blog): plain-language notes on web and mobile engineering, performance and planning
- [Start a project](https://alaz.pro/start-project): three-step project brief form

## Products

- [Vocabulary](https://alaz.pro/case-studies/english-vocabulary): a swipe-card app for the 8,000 most common English words, with audio on every card, 17 word games, spaced-repetition review and 24 interface languages. Flutter, iOS and Android.
- [Market Hours](https://alaz.pro/case-studies/market-hours): a live world map and alarm app showing which stock exchanges and forex sessions are open right now, with holidays, lunch breaks and alerts. Web dashboard live at https://markethours.live; mobile app in preparation.

- [How Long Does It Take to Build a Web or Mobile App?](https://alaz.pro/blog/how-long-does-it-take-to-build-an-app): realistic timelines for MVPs, internal tools and platforms, and what moves them
- [What Does a Slow Website Actually Cost Your Business?](https://alaz.pro/blog/cost-of-a-slow-website): research-backed numbers on speed, conversions, ad spend and Core Web Vitals
